numbering: Episodes numbered continuously 1–24 across both seasons (Season 2 is 13–24).

arcs.name: Komi's First Friends
arcs.summary: Average boy Hitohito Tadano discovers that the school's untouchable beauty Shoko Komi simply can't talk to people, and promises to help her make 100 friends.
events: Tadano and Komi talk through a blackboard and become her first friend.
Najimi Osana, who claims to be everyone's childhood friend, joins in.
Komi is crowned the class 'goddess', and Yamai and Agari join her circle.

arcs.name: Summer Break
arcs.summary: Summer break brings Komi her first outings with friends.
events: Komi visits Tadano's home and they share an umbrella.
A pool trip ends with Tadano holding Komi's hand.
Komi's grandmother notices her crush during Obon.

arcs.name: Sports Day and Culture Festival
arcs.summary: The fall events give Komi a chance to take part in school life for the first time.
events: Komi runs the relay at sports day and feels jealous of Onemine.
The class runs a maid café at the culture festival.
The season ends with a dance and a karaoke after-party.

arcs.name: Winter Holidays
arcs.summary: Winter brings new classmates, Christmas and New Year's to Komi's growing circle.
events: The stern Katai joins the group after being mistaken for a delinquent.
Komi gets a joint Christmas and birthday celebration.
Komi visits Tadano when he catches a fever.

arcs.name: Kyoto Field Trip
arcs.summary: Komi worries about the class trip to Kyoto and who she will spend it with.
events: Komi confides her worries about the trip to Najimi in a letter.
On day two, Komi realizes she has a crush on Tadano and falls asleep on his shoulder.

arcs.name: Valentine's and White Day
arcs.summary: The end of first year approaches with Valentine's Day and White Day.
events: Komi gives Tadano chocolate after encouragement.
Komi and Tadano have their first fight.
Tadano gives Komi hand cream for White Day as their first year ends.

filler.note: No filler: every episode adapts the manga.
